name: Run success outcome → executing→completed
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a — the terminal-success transition. Fires on the RUN entity when a success outcome (agent.run.outcome=success) has been stamped there AND the run is `executing`. Advances the run to `completed` via lifecycle_transition.

WHY outcome-driven, not respond_direct-driven (Coby review P1b): coordinator/03b-respond-direct fires on EVERY respond_direct — including the limitation path ('the request cannot be served': research/06, autoresearch/10 plateau/environment-failure), whose recovery coordinators DO carry a run anchor and would otherwise mis-complete a failed run. Instead, the three reviewer/CBG-APPROVED rules (research/07, autoresearch/08, dev-via-test/07a — the unambiguous success terminals, carrying wakeup_mode=chain_terminal_*) stamp agent.run.outcome=success on the run entity. This decouples completion from respond_direct entirely: 03b stays purely reply-delivery, and the limitation/front-door respond_direct paths never stamp success → never complete (their failed/cancelled outcomes are Phase 4a′/4b).

The success marker is DURABLE on the run entity, so the early-marker race (success stamped while still `dispatched`) is benign: this rule is simply not-matching (phase guard is a top-level condition) until dispatched→executing writes the later KV revision, on which the processor re-evaluates every rule (message_handler.go:245) and this rule enters exactly once (stale-replay guard). Per-pack note: the success-stamp SUBJECT differs by pack (research uses agent.run.entity_id; autoresearch + dev-via-test use lineage.run-loop-entity-id) because their chains descend through different spawn paths — but all resolve to the same run entity, so this rule's run-entity-side condition is uniform.

on_enter.reason: chain reached its success terminal (reviewer/CBG approved) — run completed

metadata.stamped_by: research/07 + autoresearch/08 + dev-via-test/07a add_triple agent.run.outcome=success (per-pack subject — see those rules).
metadata.outcome_driven_rationale: Decoupled from respond_direct so the limitation respond_direct paths (research/06, autoresearch/10) cannot mis-complete a failed run (Coby review P1b). See §E.
metadata.phase_guard_is_condition: agent.run.phase==executing is a TOP-LEVEL CONDITION; a durable success marker stamped early stays not-matching until executing, then enters on the later KV revision (message_handler.go:245). Coby review round 2 / §G2.
metadata.exactly_once: After completion phase==completed → condition false → no re-fire; a duplicate success stamp leaves the condition false (not-matching), so no invalid-edge ErrTerminalPhase is attempted (no ERROR log).
